paper: From Flat to Hierarchical: Evolving Tree-structured Thoughts for Fine-grained Alpha Mining
headline_strategy: TreEvo evolves hierarchical thought trees with LLM initialization, crossover, three mutation modes and pruning; generated trees are converted into executable alpha factors, evaluated on future five-day returns, and selected into a daily Top-50/Drop-5 portfolio
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because no implementation, seed trees, thought-to-code converter, generated factor expression, parser, trajectory, or portfolio output is released
missing_headline_objects: TreEvo implementation, dependency environment, execution sandbox and runner
actual seed trees, filled prompts, model snapshots, responses, seeds and search trajectories
the thought-tree-to-executable-code prompt, schema, parser and correction policy
generated factor expressions/code, factor scores, selected population and five-run outputs
point-in-time universe memberships, market-data snapshot, adjustment and calendar rules
portfolio weights, holdings, costs, daily returns and raw table/figure arrays

rejected_substitutes.route: Generate a factor from the 22 operator names
rejected_substitutes.reason: An operator vocabulary does not identify the paper's evolved tree, code-generation semantics, parser, parameters, or selected output.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run the seven templates using invented seed trees and a current LLM
rejected_substitutes.reason: The crucial thought-to-code prompt and runtime fills are missing, and the v1 model has an unresolved pre-release timing conflict.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the synthetic IC/RankIC fixture as a strategy
rejected_substitutes.reason: It verifies metric equations only and contains no factor, security score, or holding.

rejected_substitutes.route: Infer factors or returns from tables and figures
rejected_substitutes.reason: The displays contain aggregate outcomes, not expressions, dated predictions, holdings or return arrays, and several same-version values conflict.

rejected_substitutes.route: Substitute an unrelated evolutionary alpha-mining implementation
rejected_substitutes.reason: No attributable implementation was found, so another system would not preserve TreEvo's exact tree operators and search.

result_policy: No operator-derived invention, fresh LLM tree, metric fixture, figure inference, or unrelated alpha miner is entered as a TreEvo return. The positive factor/portfolio claims remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
